risk_factors.name: Active Psychosis Risk
risk_factors.description: Current or recent psychotic symptoms or strong vulnerability to psychosis in unsupported contexts.
risk_factors.contraindication_notes: May be contraindicated for unsupervised or high-intensity psychedelic protocols pending specialist review.

risk_factors.name: Unmanaged Suicidality
risk_factors.description: Active suicidal intent or inadequate safety planning and support.
risk_factors.contraindication_notes: Requires escalation and stabilization before deeper experiential work.
